description: Monthly Electricity Generation by IWPP (MWh) is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset presents the monthly electricity generation in megawatt-hours (MWh) by each Independent Water and Power Producer (IWPP), including conventional and photovoltaic sources. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are electricity, monthly, power plant, solar. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
